title: A stranger in the lanes of Upeh
body: Your clerk mentions it in passing while he trims the lamp. A thin man with a cut on his scalp was seen in the lanes of Upeh this evening, asking which Gujarati houses could hide a guest. He spoke the Malay of Pedir. The Salamat cleared this morning with fourteen crates of frankincense, six of rosewater, and no passengers declared.

choices.label: Send men to find him
choices.outcome_text: Your men search until midnight and find only a rented mat, still warm, in a house that swears no one was there. Whatever he carried has gone deeper into the city.

choices.label: Leave it to the temenggung’s watch
choices.outcome_text: It is not the shahbandar’s business who sleeps in Upeh. The watch hears of it days later, too late to ask him anything.
